_comment: Claude Code handoff: finish the W4 UX approval-gate verification on live SIT. This is not a docs-only review task. Claude must validate the clickable webapp and return a final gate decision with evidence.
title: Close the W4 Export + Configurator approval gate on live SIT with clickable webapp proof
lane: Claude Code - UX acceptance plus live browser verification
objective: Finish the W4 approval-gate verification on live SIT. Do not stop at document review. Open the real webapp, log in, click through the production-facing review surface, verify the 5 approval items from docs/ux/UX-FREEZE-EXPORT-CONFIGURATOR.md against the live UI, and return a final pass/fail result with evidence.

background.user_report: User reported that the SIT surface looked static like the reference prototype and asked whether the W4 UX freeze gate really requires a genuinely clickable SIT environment before TASK-1003 and TASK-1006 can begin.
background.repo_state: Current repo guidance already separates production-facing review vs demo/reference surfaces. The production-facing route is /phase2/prototype backed by src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html. Legacy workflow-demo remains available only for internal comparison.
background.current_need: What is still missing is final browser-driven proof against the real live surface for the 5 approval-gate items. This task exists to close that gap honestly.

production_review_surface.rule: This is the only valid W4 SIT/UAT approval surface.

legacy_demo_surface.rule: Reference only. Do not use this as primary approval proof.

reference_prototype_doc.rule: Reference baseline only. Not runtime proof.

static_fallback.rule: Parity check only. Not enough by itself for gate closure.

approval_gate_items: Export page has two paths: Quick Export (all fields, no transforms, xlsx default) and Template Export (template-driven, full column adjust, csv/xlsx).
Export page Step 1 shows mode picker (Quick vs Template) after document selection.
Column adjust panel is inline full-width on Export page (not modal), per-run by default, with optional Save as Template / Update Template.
Template Configurator is a 3-tab persistent setup page, separate from Export, accessed from Manage Templates.
TASK-1009 Schema Analyzer is present as the upstream path before TASK-1003/TASK-1006 and is visible/usable in the live review surface.
what_claude_must_do: 1. Read the source-of-truth docs first, especially docs/ux/UX-FREEZE-EXPORT-CONFIGURATOR.md section 9 Approval Gate.
2. Open a fresh browser session against https://sit.yahwan.biz/phase2/prototype using the operator-supplied Basic Auth credentials.
3. Log in through the real app login form using the operator-supplied app credentials.
4. Verify that the app is genuinely interactive, not a static HTML shell: navigation must change screens, buttons must respond, and relevant flows must render distinct content.
5. Click through the production-facing UI and evaluate the 5 approval items against the live webapp.
6. Check browser console and failing network requests while navigating. Record any 401, 404, 500, or broken JS behavior.
7. Also open https://sit.yahwan.biz/index.html in a fresh reload and confirm whether it behaves the same as /phase2/prototype after the cache fix.
8. If any approval item is missing or unclear, report FAIL or UNCLEAR honestly with exact screen/path evidence. Do not silently reinterpret the gate as passed.
9. If all 5 items are not clearly present and usable on the live production-facing surface, state that TASK-1003 and TASK-1006 must remain blocked.
minimum_click_paths: Login screen -> dashboard or app shell visible
Open Manage Templates or Template Configurator entry
Open Schema Analyzer / Upload & Detect area if present
Navigate to the production-facing Export-related flow
Attempt to observe document-selection -> mode-picker -> adjust/panel structure
Confirm whether export is still old embedded step behavior or the new full-page flow
acceptance_criteria: A real browser session is used on live SIT, not only curl or static file inspection.
PASS, FAIL, or UNCLEAR is returned for each of the 5 approval items.
Every item result includes route or screen evidence from the live production-facing surface.
Console and network errors are checked and summarized.
A final gate decision is produced: either approval gate closed, or still blocked with exact reasons.
The answer clearly distinguishes live clickable proof from document/reference proof.
credentials_handling: Basic Auth credentials and app login credentials are operator-supplied out of band. Do not commit, print, or store plaintext credentials in repo files, logs, screenshots, or handoff artifacts.

sections: Approval gate result table (5 items: PASS/FAIL/UNCLEAR)

final_instruction_to_claude: This task is only complete when you have tested the live clickable webapp and returned a final gate decision with evidence. A docs-only review, static HTML comparison, or API-only verification is not enough.
